caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object with a curved top and a slightly indented middle section, resembling a cushion or upholstered panel. The overall color of the object is a muted peach or salmon pink, serving as the background for various ornamental designs. The upper section features a stylized floral and geometric pattern, with white, pink, and green hues forming flowers, leaves, and diamond shapes. Along the midline, there is a horizontal band shaded in blue, which is decorated with a repeating motif of small flowers in pink and white and a trim of green on both sides. Below this band, the lower section of the object displays a large, green peacock standing amidst leafy green clusters with scattered small pink flowers and white floral outlines. The same pink, green, and white color palette is used throughout the design, creating a cohesive look. In the bottom left corner, there is a signature reading “N. Acampora 1937,” and in the bottom right corner, a small, labeled scale in inches appears, indicating the intended measurement for the depicted object.
title: Bandbox
